content.text:
I made one change to `0.html`; the rest of the stylesheet held up to review and I left it alone. I did not open it in a browser.

## What changed

**Caption-above-content figures** (`0.html:84`): a `<figcaption>` placed first in a `<figure>` had its gap on the wrong side, with 0.5rem above it and nothing between it and the content below. It now gets the gap below instead:

```css
figcaption:first-child {
  margin-block: 0 0.5rem;
}
```

Captions placed after the content behave as before.

## What I left alone

I went through the rest looking for bugs in the heading and section spacing, the last-child margin reset, table overflow, form controls, print styles, and right-to-left and safe-area handling. I found nothing else worth changing. Further tweaks there would be matters of taste, not fixes.

## What needs your input

- **Content:** the title and `<h1>` are both the placeholder `0`, and there is no `<meta name="description">`. I didn't invent text for either.
- **Scrollable `<pre>` and `<table>`:** wide ones scroll horizontally, but Safari doesn't make those regions keyboard-focusable. The fix is `tabindex="0"` on the element in the markup, which only matters once the page has any.
